title: How Language Models Choose Sides: Internal Representations of Instruction Hierarchy
abstract: arXiv:2608.28648v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how instruction-tuned LLMs arbitrate direct conflicts between system and user instructions. We introduce a benchmark of 41 paired constraints with deterministic verifiers and evaluate eight models under matched baseline, conflict, and same-channel control conditions. Behaviourally, the models split into three regimes by System Authority Delta: hierarchy-respecting models use the system channel as an authority signal, anti-hierarchy models follow the system less often than their same-channel baseline predicts, and no-effect models show little channel sensitivity. Llama-3.1-8B is the strongest anti-hierarchy case in our suite, following the system in only 0.10 of conflict trials. We use this behavioural failure case to ask whether user-preferring arbitration reflects the absence of an internal conflictresolution signal. It does not: on Llama-3.1-8B, the conflict outcome is linearly decodable from residual-stream activations at 0.9

translated_title: 语言模型如何选择立场：指令层级的内部表征
translated_abstract: 我们研究了指令微调的大语言模型如何在系统指令与用户指令的直接冲突中进行仲裁。我们引入了一个包含41对约束条件并配有确定性验证器的基准测试，并在匹配的基线、冲突和同通道控制条件下评估了八个模型。从行为层面看，模型根据“系统权威差值”分为三种模式：尊重层级的模型将系统通道作为权威信号，反层级模型遵循系统指令的频率低于其同通道基线所预测的水平，而无效应模型几乎不表现出通道敏感性。Llama-3.1-8B 是我们测试套件中最强的反层级案例，在冲突试验中仅有 0.10 的比例遵循系统指令。我们利用这一行为失败案例来探究：偏好用户的仲裁是否反映了内部缺乏冲突解决信号。事实并非如此：在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，冲突结果可以从残差流激活中以 0.9 的准确率被线性解码出来。
tldr: 本研究通过包含41对约束的基准测试发现指令微调模型在系统与用户指令冲突时分为尊重层级、反层级和无效应三种模式，并证明即使在反层级表现最强的 Llama-3.1-8B 中，冲突结果仍可从残差流激活中高准确率地线性解码，表明模型内部实际存在冲突解决信号。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a benchmark of 41 paired constraints revealing that instruction-tuned LLMs fall into three arbitration regimes under system-user conflicts, and demonstrates that even in the strongly anti-hierarchy Llama-3.1-8B, conflict outcomes are linearly decodable from residual-stream activations with 0.9 accuracy, indicating an internal conflict-resolution signal does exist.
